assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are provisional rough intake geometry from the repository; official polygons must replace them before professional scoring or statutory use.
assumptions.impact: All spatial areas, figures, and derived layers require full recalculation after official geometry is released.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage controls, fire safety, and engineering constraints are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, setback, engineering, implementation, and retain-renovate-demolish conclusions remain unknown or conceptual.

assumptions.statement: Lunar-rhythm operations, Moon Print records, events, and pilgrimage landmarks are concept proposals; names, schedules, owners, approvals, and budgets are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Operational performance must be validated by future professional and community governance.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios use only authorized, minimized, aggregated, and human-reviewable data in the proposal; no personal trajectories or internal enterprise data are included.
assumptions.impact: Any future deployment requires separate data, ethics, security, and accessibility review.
